title: Hazel and the Sigil
author: Rosalind Eriksen
blurb: Sable Vane, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
